u0: Initial pre-key state: the agent has not yet acquired the yellow key and the locked door is still closed. Current progress is only the starting position; the next objective is to locate the accessible key on the starting side and pick it up. Until the first pickup, there is no key in possession and no key-loss event.
u1: Key-acquired state: the agent is carrying the yellow key, but the door has not yet been opened. The next objective is to reach the locked door and toggle it open while keeping or reacquiring the key. If the key is dropped before the door opens, key_lost can occur and the agent must pick it up again; the state remains focused on opening the door.
u2: Door-opened state: the yellow door has been unlocked and opened at least once, so the remaining objective is to pass through if needed and reach the green goal. The key may still be carried or may have been dropped after opening; dropping it now is not key_lost. If the door has been toggled shut again, reopen it and continue toward the goal.
u3: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the goal after the door was opened, so the task is complete. The episode ends on this step; there is no further objective or action to take.
